svg.title: NYC Taxi Data Engineering — Architecture
svg.desc: Target pipeline architecture. Gray: external source and runtime. Blue: collection. Purple: processing. Teal: warehouse. Green: applications. Dashed arrows mark local staging, exploration, and the runtime link. exo1 retrieves TLC monthly Parquet files into the nyc_raw prefix of RustFS bucket nyc-taxi, either directly or by downloading to local data/raw and uploading. The exo2 Spark job runs on the Spark cluster, reads nyc_raw, and validates once. From the same validated data, branch 1 writes cleaned Parquet to nyc_cleaned and branch 2 writes to the PostgreSQL warehouse, schema dw, whose tables are created by the exo3 SQL scripts. exo4 reads the warehouse with read-only SQL and explores nyc_cleaned. exo5 trains on nyc_cleaned, saves the model artifact in models, and loads it for inference.
